metadata.title: A continuous free product system not generated by its tensor core
metadata.description:
We construct an associative pointed free product system of separable complex Hilbert spaces whose maximal ordered tensor subsystem does not generate the whole free system. Its tensor core is the time-ordered finite-word Fock system, and the closed free hull of that core is the full finite-word Fock system. The ambient system has additional nonzero orthogonal sectors of ordinal words of length below omega squared. A recoverable sigma-finite Gaussian mixture and coordinate-retaining finite-prefix absorption yield countable maximal-run charts and pointed free-product unitaries. The paper proves full associativity and an explicit continuous-field structure including time zero, positive-time local triviality, and continuity of the structural maps and their inverses. A quantitative finite-positive-measure grade-omega witness proves properness for every positive time.

This gives a negative answer in the scalar specialization to the universal tensor-core generation question posed by Michael Skeide in Oberwolfach Reports 6 (2009), 528-530, DOI10.4171/OWR/2009/09. It does not resolve adapted-cocycle, forward tensor-recovery or general classification questions. The stated explicit continuity convention is part of the theorem; arbitrary stronger regularity axioms are not asserted. Classical Fock constructions, standard Gaussian/Radon-Nikodym tools and nonclassical tensor-noise context are credited. The known forward construction from any spatial tensor input has generating tensor core by a direct hull-monotonicity argument, so it cannot itself give this proper-core-hull obstruction.

The source and verification ZIP preserves all eleven original files and three sealed scoped AI review families, primary-source URLs/hashes and exact reading scopes, new explicitly guarded integrity/reproduction tools, and meaningful normal/optimized negative controls. The bounded source investigation authenticated no earlier exact negative construction in the inspected passages. The named in-preparation manuscript remains unrecovered; unrecorded talks, unpublished/unindexed work and differently formulated results are not excluded. No worldwide-firstness or still-open-in-2026 claim is made. Historical assertion-based scripts are preserved unchanged and replayed only with assertions enabled by the new wrapper. Finite computations supplement, and do not certify, the analytic infinite-dimensional proof.

AI tools were extensively involved in research planning, proof development/reconstruction, computational checks, literature search/comparison, manuscript writing and adversarial auditing. This is an unrefereed preprint and has received no formal independent human peer review or proof-assistant certification. Inherited-context AI scientific reviews are explicitly distinguished from blind or human review.
